import pandas as pd

# Read input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_info = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missing_info.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
report_df = pd.DataFrame(missing_info)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select kept indicators
kept_mask = report_df['kept']
kept_indicator_cols = report_df[report_df['kept']]['indicator'].tolist()

# Write selected matrix with city_id, city_name, year and kept indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicator_cols]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
